what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Ethiopia in Egypt: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 13237 Ethiopian asylum seekers in Egypt, 8.9% of all asylum seekers from Ethiopia.
Refugees from Ethiopia, a separate group, live mostly in Sudan, Kenya, Uganda and South Africa.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Ethiopia with the TPLF and GLF from 2020 to 2022, and over the government and Amhara territory with Fano from 2023 to 2025, at war level in those years.
It also records armed conflict over Oromiya territory in many years, most recently with the OLA from 2019 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 517 asylum seekers.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Egypt.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Egypt only.
